title.narrative: Algeria FCDO Engaging and Empowering Algeria as a Democratic Climate and Environmental Action Driver

description.narrative: The programme will work with parliamentary staff and members of both House to support the Algerian parliament in becoming a more central player in environmental governance, by:• Improving their understanding of environmental and climate issues.• Equipping them with tools and knowledge for effective environmental and climate legislation and oversight.• Incentivising action on environment and climate issues. • Strengthening dialogue between parliament, academics/experts and civil society on environment and climate issues.
